in_marathi.name: Pratham
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pratham हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘prathama’ meaning ‘first’ or ‘foremost’. In Hindu mythology, Pratham is also the name of the first celestial being or deity. It is believed that naming a child Pratham will bring them good fortune and success in their endeavors.
